workflow_runs.display_title: pm-257/t-1607: Build bounded ghost rooms and Worker adapter

head_commit.message:
pm-257/t-1607: Build bounded ghost rooms and Worker adapter

Add the ink-ghosts transport: shared protocol, upgrade policy and pure room
(two rooms, exact origins, 24-socket cap, 128-byte frames, 15/s token bucket
over every attempt, five invalid frames then 1008), a hibernating GhostRoom
Durable Object Worker in its own locked package (typecheck, test:local in
workerd with a live-state reconstruction suite, bundle:check via wrangler
deploy --dry-run, /version fingerprint), and a dependency-free local fake
that runs the same contract cases. No storage, logs, cookies, IP or UA.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

workflow_runs.display_title: pm-271/t-1561: Render the Tamatebako in a test, real and empty changelog

head_commit.message:
pm-271/t-1561: Render the Tamatebako in a test, real and empty changelog

The box's source checks never rendered it, and the empty-history state was
never seen rendered. tamatebako-render.test.ts compiles the real
component with the repo's TypeScript and renders it with react-dom/server.
The committed history.json gives a shut box over a labelled range
scrubber at the newest commit, with its date, subject and sha on fresh
paper. An empty index gives the empty box and no scrubber. Each case is
the other's negative control. wiring.test.ts now requires the file.

workflow_runs.display_title: pm-271/t-1562: Add opt-in palace sea sound with a Pocket switch

head_commit.message:
pm-271/t-1562: Add opt-in palace sea sound with a Pocket switch

The palace makes a quiet low-passed brown-noise sea with Web Audio, only
after a click or key there, off by default. Pocket's Sea sound chip and
the palace's own button share localStorage ryugu-sound; switching off in
either stops it, a hidden page suspends it, and leaving closes it. No
Web Audio leaves the button disabled and the palace silent.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
